lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, sells up to 67,500 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹9.13 crore if all offered shares are sold; the offer price is shown and employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Timing: the money has been in hand since listing, with trading starting March 11, 2026, so the call is timely now that the liquidity event has occurred.
Family link: shares the surname Dixit with Amit Arun Dixit, and the middle name Amit of Ashwini Amit Dixit is the first name of Amit Arun Dixit.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹64.08 crore valued at offer price; the average cost of acquisition and gain are unknown, as this has not been verified.
